questions.cardText:
[Political Science] What is the political ideology advocating for minimal state intervention in the lives of citizens?
A. Socialism
B. Liberalism
C. Libertarianism
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welche politische Ideologie tritt für möglichst geringe staatliche Eingriffe in das Leben der Bürger ein?
questions.en: What is the political ideology that advocates minimal state intervention in the lives of citizens?

timeline.labelEn: Robert Nozick publishes Anarchy, State, and Utopia, a landmark case for the minimal state
timeline.labelDe: Robert Nozick veröffentlicht „Anarchie, Staat, Utopia“, ein Grundlagenwerk für den Minimalstaat

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] Which of the following is true about lean people?
A. They fidget more
B. They slack off more
C. They complain more
Answer: A. Recent research has shown that lean people tend to engage in more non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT), such as fidgeting, which helps them burn more calories throughout the day. This constant movement significantly contributes to their ability to maintain a lower body weight.
questions.de: Welche kleine, unruhige Bewegung – eine Form der Thermogenese durch Alltagsaktivität (NEAT) – machen schlanke Menschen tendenziell häufiger und verbrennen so über den Tag mehr Kalorien?
questions.en: What small restless movement, a form of non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT), do lean people tend to do more, burning extra calories through the day?

timeline.labelEn: James A. Levine publishes his review of non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT), including fidgeting
timeline.labelDe: James A. Levine veröffentlicht seine Übersichtsarbeit zur Thermogenese durch Alltagsaktivität (NEAT), Zappeln eingeschlossen

questions.notes: Wikipedia: people who fidget regularly tend to weigh less because they burn more calories; NEAT is also lower in obese individuals.
